errors.noUserData: No user data found in database

direct.connected: Account, permissions and browser CORS checked
direct.keyHint: Requires GETROTE and SENDROTE; images require UPLOADATTACHMENT and videos also require UPLOADVIDEO. OpenKey stays only in session memory.
direct.privateHint: Private by default. Existing source notes are skipped.
direct.preserveHint: Preserves source visibility. Existing source notes are skipped by default.
direct.overwrite: Explicitly overwrite existing source notes (requires EDITROTE)
direct.connectFirst: Connect your Rote instance to import directly.
direct.resultDetails: View individual results and failure details

errors.invalid_instance_url: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, query parameters or fragments.
errors.instance_upgrade_required: This instance does not support formal OpenKey imports. Upgrade Rote and reconnect.
errors.network_or_cors: Connection failed. Check the URL, network and instance CORS allowlist for this Rerote origin.
errors.attachment_network_or_cors: Attachment download or upload failed. Check source/storage CORS and network.
errors.unsupported_media: Unsupported attachment type. Audio and files cannot be uploaded as images.
errors.image_decode_failed: The browser cannot decode this image. Supply a supported original format.
errors.webp_encode_failed: WebP encoding failed. No substitute preview was uploaded.
errors.preview_limit_exceeded: All WebP attempts exceeded 512 KiB. The attachment was not uploaded.
errors.video_decode_failed: The browser could not generate a video poster. The attachment was not uploaded.
errors.attachment_permission_required: The instance or OpenKey does not allow attachment uploads.
errors.video_permission_required: The instance or OpenKey does not allow video uploads.
errors.attachment_size_exceeded: The original exceeds the instance size limit.
errors.attachment_count_exceeded: The note exceeds the instance attachment count limit.
errors.cleanup_pending: Resource cleanup is pending. Retry; bound attachments are protected.
errors.cancelled_retry_to_confirm: Cancelled. Retry checks the source to confirm the commit outcome.
errors.commit_result_unknown: Commit outcome is unknown. Retry checks the source to avoid duplicate imports.
errors.dinox_invalid_date: Creation time is missing or invalid.
